individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots are heatmap-style visualizations over tissue coordinates, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The spatial deconvolution plots show per-spot values on a color scale; there are no error bars or summary statistics requiring definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: Individual sample dots are overlaid on top of each box plot for both groups and all four cell populations.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile box, with explicit minima, median, maxima, Q1 and Q3 for every group).

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment plots show a single running-score curve with NES/FDR/P values; no error bars are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar represents a single computed log2 fold-change value (with associated P value) from differential gene expression analysis, not a mean of replicate measurements, so individual points are not applicable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar chart shows single log2 fold-change values per gene with P values annotated; no error bars are displayed.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.
